_note: Short-term gains on equity shares, equity-oriented fund units and business-trust units sold with securities transaction tax, charged apart from total income (D-244). TY 2026-27: Income-tax Act, 2025 s.196(1)(i) (p.220): "income-tax calculated on such short-term capital gains at the rate of 20%"; (1)(ii) the balance of total income taxed as if it were the total income. TY 2025-26: Income-tax Act, 1961 s.111A(1)(i)(b) as substituted by the Finance (No. 2) Act, 2024 s.29 (p.26): "at the rate of twenty per cent. for any transfer which takes place on or after the 23rd day of July, 2024" — every transfer of TY 2025-26. The shortfall of s.196(2) / the s.111A(1) first proviso is RATE-CG-SHORTFALL-ORDER's; Chapter VIII is kept off these gains by s.196(4) / s.111A(2) (ChapterEightNode). Sources: docs/taxplanning-build/sources/2026-10-18-capital-gains-basis.md rows 16, 19.
